newsitem.title: DUBAI: Oman oil refinery maintenance set for March 1997.
newsitem.headline: Oman oil refinery maintenance set for March 1997.

text.p: Oman's 80,000 barrels per day (bpd) Mina al-Fahal refinery will undergo scheduled maintenance work starting in March 1997, Gulf oil industry sources said on Monday.
Details of the duration and scope of the work at the plant, which supplies the local market and exports mainly fuel oil, were not immediately available.
The refinery underwent two days of partial maintenance at the end of last month to allow heat exchangers to be changed, an industry source said.
